title: UI-TARS-2 Technical Report: Advancing GUI Agent with Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning
best_for_zh: 研究智能体环境、rollout 与后训练披露的读者
one_line: UI-TARS-2 discloses a continual-pre-training/SFT/PPO flywheel over stateful GUI episodes and three outcome-feedback paths, while leaving the training corpus, reward records, model weights, and replayable environments unreleased.
UI-TARS-2 披露数据飞轮、多轮 RL 与大规模 rollout 沙箱，但未披露训练记录和奖励账本。
why: For the frontier-report disclosure ledger, it is a strong example of method-level transparency without item-level data or environment reproducibility: the episode contract can be reconstructed conceptually, but the claimed pipeline cannot be independently audited end to end.
inclusion_reason: A frontier GUI-agent report with unusually detailed episode, environment, data-routing, reward, and optimizer descriptions, but without the assets needed to independently reconstruct or replay its training pipeline.

title: Problem
问题
html:
A GUI-agent training example is not just an instruction paired with a final answer. It is an episode unfolding inside mutable software: the policy receives a task, a recent interaction context and compressed memory, observes pixels or tool output, emits a GUI or SDK action, observes the next state, and continues until success, failure, or a budget boundary. A useful disclosure must therefore cover the task source, state and observation representation, action space, memory, environment version, termination rule, reward, and record lineage.

UI-TARS-2 addresses how to produce and optimize such long-horizon episodes at scale. The report spans desktop, mobile, browser, terminal, software-development, MCP-style tool, and game settings, where actions can change a shared filesystem and later observations depend on earlier actions. This makes a trajectory meaningful only together with its stateful environment and reset conditions.

The report supplies substantial method-level detail but not an open training-data artifact. It names source families, annotation procedures, filtering stages, three feedback paths, and a large sandbox architecture, yet does not publish the task inventory, episode corpus, accepted/rejected routing ledger, reward records, environment images, or the UI-TARS-2 checkpoint. The audit problem is therefore to distinguish a described data factory from a released, replayable dataset.

GUI 智能体的训练样本并不是“指令—最终答案”二元组，而是在可变软件环境中展开的一段 episode：策略接收任务、近期交互上下文与压缩记忆，读取像素或工具输出，发出 GUI 或 SDK 动作，再观察下一状态，直到成功、失败或触及预算边界。因而，合格的披露需要同时说明任务来源、状态与观测表示、动作空间、记忆、环境版本、终止规则、奖励以及记录血缘。

UI-TARS-2 处理的是如何规模化生成并优化这类长时程 episode。报告覆盖桌面、移动端、浏览器、终端、软件开发、MCP 风格工具和游戏场景；动作可以改写共享文件系统，后续观测也依赖此前动作。因此，一条轨迹只有和有状态环境及其重置条件放在一起才有可解释性。

该报告的方法级披露较丰富，但没有形成开放训练数据资产。论文列出来源类型、标注过程、过滤阶段、三条反馈路径与大规模沙箱架构，却未发布任务清单、episode 语料、接受/拒绝路由账本、奖励记录、环境镜像或 UI-TARS-2 权重。这里的审计重点，是把“被描述的数据工厂”与“已发布且可回放的数据集”严格区分开。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central construction is an iterative data flywheel around continual pre-training (CT), supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL). It starts from Seed-thinking-1.6. The current RL policy generates new environment-interaction episodes; a validation function sends higher-quality episodes to SFT and lower-quality episodes to CT, after which the CT-to-SFT-to-RL cycle repeats. The report does not disclose the validation function, routing threshold, yields, or record-level routing decisions.

The episode abstraction follows ReAct. A step interleaves a reasoning trace, an action, and an observation. Actions include mouse, keyboard, scrolling, PyAutoGUI or ADB operations, and SDK functions for terminals, files, software development, and other tools. Working Memory retains recent steps at higher fidelity, while Episodic Memory compresses earlier intentions and outcomes. The exact context-window policy and memory serialization are unknown.

The environment is part of the data object. Cloud VMs cover Windows, Ubuntu, and Android; browser and game sandboxes expose visual observations and selected runtime state; a unified SDK handles allocation, initialization, interaction, screenshots or recordings, evaluation, and resource release. The report says the VM cluster reaches several thousand instances and several thousand queries per second, but it does not release VM images, dependency locks, browser builds, reset scripts, or session logs.

Feedback is domain-dependent. Games use deterministic functions and binary correctness; GUI-Browsing uses reference-answer judging; GUI-General uses UI-TARS-2 as a generative outcome reward model over the text history and last five screenshots. The reported game JSON carries scalar reward, termination flag, game version, and verification checksum, but the paper does not state that this schema is used for all GUI episodes or release any such records.

核心构造是围绕 continual pre-training（CT）、supervised fine-tuning（SFT）和 reinforcement learning（RL）形成迭代式数据飞轮。流程从 Seed-thinking-1.6 出发，由当前 RL 策略生成新的环境交互 episode；验证函数把较高质量 episode 送入 SFT，把较低质量 episode 送入 CT，随后重新执行 CT→SFT→RL。报告没有披露验证函数、路由阈值、各分支产量或逐条路由决定。

episode 抽象采用 ReAct：每一步交错包含推理轨迹、动作和观测。动作既包括鼠标、键盘、滚动、PyAutoGUI 或 ADB 操作，也包括终端、文件、软件开发及其他工具的 SDK 函数。Working Memory 以较高保真度保留近期步骤，Episodic Memory 则压缩更早的意图与结果；具体上下文策略和记忆序列化格式均为 unknown。

环境本身就是数据对象的一部分。云端虚拟机覆盖 Windows、Ubuntu 和 Android；浏览器与游戏沙箱提供视觉观测和部分运行时状态；统一 SDK 负责分配、初始化、交互、截图或录屏、评估与资源释放。论文称虚拟机集群达到数千实例和数千 QPS，但未发布虚拟机镜像、依赖锁定文件、浏览器构建版本、重置脚本或 session 日志。

反馈契约按领域变化：游戏使用确定性函数和二元正确性；GUI-Browsing 使用参考答案判定；GUI-General 让 UI-TARS-2 基于完整文本历史和最后五张截图生成 outcome reward。论文明确游戏 JSON 包含标量奖励、终止标志、游戏版本和验证校验和，但没有说明所有 GUI episode 都采用该模式，也没有发布相应记录。

title: Method
方法
html:
The cold start combines several channels. CT uses task tutorials, instructional videos, internet demonstrations, in-house data, and later the training data from UI-TARS and UI-TARS-1.5, including open-source agent trajectories and in-house annotations. CT and SFT also mix agent material with general chat and reasoning data, with a smaller agent fraction in CT and a larger one in SFT. Counts, mixture weights, collection dates, and source licenses are unknown.

For in-situ CT annotation, software installed on annotators' personal computers records normal application use while annotators verbalize decisions through a think-aloud audio protocol. The paper distinguishes experts demonstrating complex tasks from novices exploring unfamiliar tasks. It builds a hierarchical task graph, assigns importance and difficulty scores, verifies executability, deduplicates tasks, and uses dual-annotator review. Audio is transcribed by ASR, aligned with screen actions, and refined by language models. Consent, redaction, retention, and privacy controls are not described.

Interactive SFT is on-policy and human-in-the-loop. In a controlled cloud VM or browser sandbox, the current model proposes a reasoning trace and action. An annotator either accepts the proposal or replaces it with a better trace/action, and the resulting complete episode is stored. The task pool and model are refreshed periodically so supervision follows the current policy distribution. Candidate counts, acceptance rates, disagreement handling, and annotator qualification rules are unknown.

RL task construction has three branches. GUI-Browsing creates screenshot-only information-seeking tasks without a search API: facts from authoritative sources are obfuscated, revealing attributes are removed, linked pages form multi-hop chains, and trivial prior-knowledge or single-search tasks are filtered. GUI-General starts from public website collections, excludes inaccessible, login-gated, static-information, and casual-game sites, uses a vision-language model to extract functions, removes simple functions, and composes executable multi-condition instructions; the report states coverage of 690 websites. Gameplay uses public HTML5/WebGL games and model-generated games whose code exposes state variables to JavaScript verifiers.

Reward follows the task branch. Function-verifiable games receive binary final correctness. GUI-Browsing predictions are compared with reference answers by a judge, identified in the analysis as GPT-4o. GUI-General lacks a formal verifier or reference answer, so UI-TARS-2 acts as a generative outcome reward model and emits a scalar success score from the complete text history plus the last five screenshots. This reward model is trained with targeted annotation and single-turn RL, but its data, checkpoint, prompt, calibration, threshold, and sampling procedure are not released.

Rollouts are fully asynchronous. A server-mode inference service is decoupled from the agent framework; stateful environments persist across tool calls; training begins when completed traces in a dynamic pool meet a minimum batch threshold, while unfinished traces remain for later iterations. PPO uses primarily final-outcome rewards, optional format rewards and length penalties, Decoupled GAE, Length-Adaptive GAE, value-model pretraining, and asymmetric clipping. Domain-specialized policies are then merged by parameter interpolation. The report leaves the numerical coefficients, learning rates, batch sizes, rollout counts, sampling settings, pool threshold, and compute budget unknown.

冷启动由多条渠道组成。CT 使用任务教程、教学视频、互联网演示和内部数据，后续还纳入 UI-TARS 与 UI-TARS-1.5 的训练数据，其中包括开源智能体轨迹和内部标注。CT 与 SFT 还会混入通用对话和推理数据；CT 中智能体数据占比较小，SFT 中占比较大。总量、混合权重、采集日期和来源许可均为 unknown。

在 in-situ CT 标注中，标注软件安装在标注员个人电脑上，记录其正常使用应用的过程，同时采用 think-aloud 音频协议口述决策。论文区分了演示复杂任务的专家与探索陌生任务的新手，并构建分层任务图，设置重要度和难度分数，执行可运行性检查、去重和双人复核。音频经 ASR 转写，与屏幕动作对齐，再由语言模型润色。报告没有说明同意机制、脱敏、保留期限和隐私控制。

Interactive SFT 是 on-policy 的人机协同流程。在受控云虚拟机或浏览器沙箱内，当前模型提出推理轨迹和动作；标注员接受该建议，或改写为更合适的轨迹/动作，最终保存完整 episode。任务池与模型定期刷新，使监督分布跟随当前策略。候选数量、接受率、分歧处理和标注员资质规则均为 unknown。

RL 任务构造分三支。GUI-Browsing 构造仅依赖截图且不能调用搜索 API 的信息检索任务：从权威来源取事实，隐藏泄露答案的属性，以页面链接形成多跳链，并过滤可凭先验知识或单次搜索完成的任务。GUI-General 从公开网站集合出发，排除不可访问、需要登录、仅提供静态信息和休闲游戏的网站，再由视觉语言模型提取功能、删除过于简单的功能并组合可执行的多条件指令；报告给出的覆盖量是 690 个网站。Gameplay 使用公开 HTML5/WebGL 小游戏和模型生成游戏，后者在代码中暴露可由 JavaScript 验证器查询的状态变量。

奖励随任务分支变化。函数可验证的游戏获得最终二元正确性；GUI-Browsing 由 judge 对照参考答案，分析章节明确该 judge 为 GPT-4o；GUI-General 没有形式化验证器或参考答案，因此由 UI-TARS-2 充当 generative outcome reward model，根据完整文本历史与最后五张截图输出标量成功分。该 reward model 通过定向标注和单轮 RL 训练，但其数据、权重、输入指令、校准、阈值和采样流程均未发布。

rollout 完全异步：server-mode 推理服务与 agent framework 解耦，有状态环境在多次工具调用之间保持执行状态；动态池中完成的轨迹达到最小 batch 阈值后即开始训练，未完成轨迹留到后续迭代。PPO 主要使用最终结果奖励，并按场景加入格式奖励和长度惩罚，同时采用 Decoupled GAE、Length-Adaptive GAE、value-model pretraining 与非对称 clipping。各领域专用策略最后通过参数插值合并。系数、学习率、batch 大小、rollout 数量、采样设置、池阈值和算力预算均为 unknown。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest evidence is descriptive rather than distributive. Sections 2.1-2.6 specify the ReAct episode, two-level memory, unified VM and browser sandboxes, CT/SFT/RL flywheel, annotation paths, task synthesis, three reward routes, asynchronous rollout pool, PPO stabilizers, and parameter interpolation. These details make the intended pipeline auditable at the component level, but they do not provide records with which to reproduce it.

Several quantitative disclosures constrain the account. The GUI-General task builder covers 690 websites. The evaluation uses a 15-game in-house collection. The reward-model analysis uses an in-house set of 300 human-annotated GUI-agent traces and reports F1 83.8 for binary outcome classification, while also acknowledging a relatively high false-positive rate. That false-positive finding is directly relevant to reward reliability; the F1 score is not evidence that the training episodes are correctly sourced or labeled.

The report presents rising RL rewards, interaction-round dynamics, ablations for value pretraining and PPO variants, and downstream benchmark results. These can support claims about the trained model's observed behavior under the authors' setup. They do not establish the quality, legality, representativeness, deduplication, or reproducibility of the underlying data, and the internal environment prevented evaluation on five of 80 TerminalBench tasks.

Release evidence is narrower than the paper's method claims. The official UI-TARS repository announces UI-TARS-2 and links the report and showcase; UI-TARS-desktop is an Apache-2.0 client and agent stack. Neither checked repository provides the reported task corpus, trajectory and reward records, VM images, game-verifier bundle, or UI-TARS-2 model weights. ByteDance Seed's official Hugging Face search returns no corresponding dataset; the similarly named UI-TARS-2B-SFT model points to the earlier arXiv:2501.12326 paper and must not be treated as this report's checkpoint.

最强的证据是“描述性披露”，而不是“资产发布”。第 2.1—2.6 节明确说明 ReAct episode、两级记忆、统一虚拟机与浏览器沙箱、CT/SFT/RL 飞轮、标注路径、任务合成、三类奖励、异步 rollout 池、PPO 稳定化方法和参数插值。这些信息足以在组件层面对预期流程进行审计，却不能提供复现流程所需的记录。

若干定量披露对方法描述形成约束：GUI-General 的任务构造覆盖 690 个网站；评估使用内部 15-game collection；reward model 分析使用 300 条人工标注的内部 GUI-agent 轨迹，并报告二元结果分类 F1 为 83.8，同时承认假阳性率相对较高。假阳性现象直接关系奖励可靠性；F1 分数并不能证明训练 episode 的来源或标签质量。

论文还给出 RL 奖励上升、交互轮数变化、value pretraining 与 PPO 变体消融，以及下游 benchmark 结果。这些结果可以支撑“模型在作者设置中的行为表现”，但不能证明底层数据的质量、合法性、代表性、去重程度或可复现性；而且内部环境兼容性问题使 TerminalBench 的 80 个任务中有 5 个未参与评估。

实际发布证据比论文中的方法主张更窄。官方 UI-TARS 仓库公告 UI-TARS-2，并链接技术报告和 showcase；UI-TARS-desktop 是采用 Apache-2.0 的客户端与 agent stack。经核验，这两个仓库均未提供报告所述任务语料、轨迹与奖励记录、虚拟机镜像、游戏验证器包或 UI-TARS-2 权重。ByteDance Seed 官方 Hugging Face 检索也没有对应数据集；名称相近的 UI-TARS-2B-SFT 指向更早的 arXiv:2501.12326，不能视为本报告权重。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The contribution is the integration of several data and optimization mechanisms into one native GUI-centered training loop. Individual components—ReAct traces, human demonstrations, rejection filtering, outcome rewards, asynchronous rollout, PPO, and parameter merging—are established ideas. UI-TARS-2's distinctive element is their joint organization across heterogeneous, stateful GUI and game environments, with new policy episodes routed back into CT or SFT.

The report also makes the state/action/observation contract broader than mouse-only computer use. The same episode can combine screenshot-grounded GUI actions with terminal, file, software-development, and other SDK functions over a shared filesystem. This is important for data design because a valid replay must preserve both the visible interface and side effects produced through tools.

Its feedback design is explicitly heterogeneous rather than forcing one verifier onto every task. Deterministic runtime state serves games; reference comparison serves browsing; an outcome reward model serves open-ended GUI manipulation. This is a useful taxonomy, but it also creates non-equivalent label semantics and different failure risks across the pooled data.

Finally, independently trained vertical policies are consolidated by parameter interpolation instead of one joint multi-domain RL run. This reduces the need for a single synchronized rollout mixture, but the report does not publish the interpolation weights or checkpoint lineage. The novelty is therefore a frontier training recipe and disclosure case, not a newly released dataset or environment standard.

这项工作的贡献在于把多种数据与优化机制整合进一个以原生 GUI 为中心的训练闭环。ReAct 轨迹、人工演示、拒绝过滤、结果奖励、异步 rollout、PPO 和参数合并本身都不是新概念；UI-TARS-2 的特点是把它们统一组织到异构、有状态的 GUI 与游戏环境中，并把新策略生成的 episode 重新路由到 CT 或 SFT。

报告中的状态/动作/观测契约也超出了“只用鼠标”的 Computer Use。同一 episode 可以在共享文件系统上组合基于截图的 GUI 动作，以及终端、文件、软件开发和其他 SDK 函数。这一点对数据设计很关键，因为有效回放既要复原可见界面，也要保留工具调用产生的副作用。

反馈设计明确采用异构方案，而不是让所有任务共享一个验证器：游戏依赖确定性运行时状态，浏览任务依赖参考答案比对，开放式 GUI 操作依赖 outcome reward model。这个分类具有方法价值，但也意味着不同数据分支的标签语义并不等价，失败风险也不同。

最后，各领域策略先独立训练，再通过参数插值整合，而不是执行一次联合多领域 RL。这降低了构造单一同步 rollout 混合的要求，但论文没有发布插值权重和 checkpoint 血缘。因此，其新意属于前沿训练配方与披露案例，而不是新发布的数据集或环境标准。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The main limitation is the release boundary. No public task manifest, training episode corpus, SFT corrections, CT routing records, reward labels, accepted/rejected ledger, UI-TARS-2 checkpoint, or domain-specialized checkpoints were verified. The public research repository and desktop client are useful official artifacts, but they do not make the reported training pipeline inspectable at item level.

The episodes are not independently replayable. Windows, Ubuntu, Android, websites, browsers, applications, tools, and games are version-sensitive; shared-filesystem side effects and stateful sessions further increase dependence on exact initialization. The report does not provide VM or container images, dependency versions, website snapshots, game code and checksums as a bundle, reset scripts, action timing, timeout rules, or deterministic seeds.

Reward uncertainty is material. The GUI-General outcome reward model sees only the last five screenshots, and the 300-trace internal study reports a relatively high false-positive rate. Judge prompts, reference construction, scalar thresholds, reward weights, and human calibration are unavailable. A rising training reward can therefore reflect learning under the authors' evaluator without proving that terminal states are consistently correct.

Data governance is under-specified. In-situ demonstrations are collected on annotators' personal computers, yet consent, capture boundaries, personal-data redaction, audio and screen retention, security review, and compensation are not disclosed. Internet tutorials, videos, websites, open-source traces, games, and prior post-training data are named only by class, without an item-level license or provenance manifest.

Split and contamination controls are also unknown. The paper reports filtering and deduplication during task construction but not benchmark overlap checks, source-level holdouts, or separation across CT, SFT, RL, and evaluation. Website drift and repeated flywheel recycling can introduce near-duplicates across cycles. Benchmark performance must not be used as a substitute for this missing audit evidence.

The report itself has no comprehensive safety or failure section for UI-TARS-2. GUI and SDK actions can modify files, invoke terminals, browse authenticated contexts, or operate external services. Authorization boundaries, sandbox escape testing, dangerous-action review, and recovery from unintended side effects remain unknown.

首要局限是发布边界。经核验，没有公开任务清单、训练 episode 语料、SFT 修订记录、CT 路由记录、奖励标签、接受/拒绝账本、UI-TARS-2 权重或各领域专用权重。官方研究仓库与桌面客户端虽有价值，但不能让外部审计者在样本层检查论文所述训练流程。

这些 episode 也无法独立回放。Windows、Ubuntu、Android、网站、浏览器、应用、工具和游戏都依赖版本；共享文件系统副作用与有状态 session 又进一步放大了初始化依赖。报告没有打包提供虚拟机或容器镜像、依赖版本、网站快照、游戏代码与校验和、重置脚本、动作时序、超时规则或确定性随机种子。

奖励不确定性不可忽略。GUI-General 的 outcome reward model 只能看到最后五张截图，而 300 条内部轨迹实验还报告了相对较高的假阳性率。judge 输入指令、参考答案构造、标量阈值、奖励权重和人工校准均不可得。因此，训练奖励上升只能说明策略适应了作者的评估器，不能证明终止状态始终正确。

数据治理披露不足。in-situ 演示采集于标注员个人电脑，但同意机制、采集边界、个人信息脱敏、音频与屏幕记录保留、安全审查和报酬均未说明。互联网教程、视频、网站、开源轨迹、游戏和既有后训练数据只按类别列出，没有逐条许可与来源清单。

数据划分和污染控制同样为 unknown。论文描述任务构造中的过滤与去重，却未披露 benchmark 重叠检查、按来源留出，或 CT、SFT、RL 与评估之间的隔离方式。网站漂移和多轮飞轮回收还可能在周期之间产生近重复。不能用 benchmark 表现替代这些缺失的审计证据。

报告本身也没有为 UI-TARS-2 提供完整的安全与失败章节。GUI 和 SDK 动作可以修改文件、调用终端、访问已登录上下文或操作外部服务；授权边界、沙箱逃逸测试、危险动作复核以及非预期副作用恢复机制均为 unknown。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the frontier reports data disclosure ledger, this card is useful precisely because disclosure depth is uneven. The report exposes the conceptual episode contract, environment topology, annotation channels, task synthesis, reward branches, and optimizer scaffold, while withholding or omitting the item-level assets needed for independent reconstruction. It should be indexed as a partial frontier disclosure, not as an available GUI trajectory dataset.

Researchers designing agent data can reuse the audit schema: task instruction; Working and Episodic Memory; reasoning trace; GUI or SDK action; screenshot or tool observation; final outcome; reward route; termination flag; environment/session identifier; version and checksum; and provenance. The game JSON fields show one concrete implementation, while the missing cross-domain schema warns against assuming uniform records.

The report is also a strong case study for verifier selection. It allows comparison among deterministic runtime checks, reference-answer judging, and a learned outcome reward model. A reproduction plan should evaluate false positives, temporal evidence loss from the five-screenshot window, judge consistency, and disagreements between evaluator paths before combining their rewards.

For environment builders, the reported VM lease lifecycle, shared filesystem, state persistence, observation capture, browser/game state interfaces, and monitoring tools provide a useful systems checklist. Actual replication still requires versioned images, reset contracts, failure codes, and replay logs that are not public.

The card is not suitable as a source of downloadable training rows, exact mixture weights, a licensed data inventory, or a reproducible baseline checkpoint. Benchmark tables may motivate follow-up experiments, but they do not upgrade the report's data quality or curation status.

对“前沿报告数据披露账本”而言，这张 Card 的价值恰恰在于披露深度不均衡。论文公开了概念性的 episode 契约、环境拓扑、标注渠道、任务合成、奖励分支和优化脚手架，却没有提供独立重建所需的样本级资产。因此，它应被归类为“部分披露的前沿报告”，而不是“可用的 GUI 轨迹数据集”。

从事智能体数据设计的研究者可以复用这里的审计字段：任务指令、Working Memory 与 Episodic Memory、推理轨迹、GUI 或 SDK 动作、截图或工具观测、最终结果、奖励路径、终止标志、环境/session 标识、版本与校验和、来源血缘。游戏 JSON 给出一个具体实现，而跨领域统一 schema 的缺失提醒读者不要默认所有记录同构。

该报告也适合作为验证器选择案例，用来比较确定性运行时检查、参考答案判定和学习式 outcome reward model。复现计划应先评估假阳性、五截图窗口造成的时序证据丢失、judge 一致性，以及不同评估路径之间的分歧，再考虑混合奖励。

对环境构建者而言，虚拟机租约生命周期、共享文件系统、状态持久化、观测采集、浏览器/游戏状态接口和监控工具构成了有用的系统检查表。但真正复刻仍需要未公开的版本化镜像、重置契约、失败码和回放日志。

这张 Card 不适合充当可下载训练行、精确混合权重、合规数据清单或可复现 baseline 权重的来源。benchmark 表格可以启发后续实验，但不能据此提升报告的数据质量判断或策展状态。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Sections 2.1-2.2 first to reconstruct the actual data unit: task, two-level memory, reasoning/action/observation steps, shared state, and environment lifecycle.
  • In Sections 2.3-2.5, keep three stages separate: source acquisition and CT annotation, on-policy interactive SFT correction, and RL task/reward construction. The paper's flywheel connects them but does not publish the routing ledger.
  • Treat the reward contract as three contracts, not one: deterministic game functions, reference-answer judging for GUI-Browsing, and UI-TARS-2 outcome scoring for GUI-General.
  • Pair the 300-trace reward-model result with its stated false-positive issue. It is evaluator evidence, not proof of training-data quality.
  • Check official artifacts by identity, not name similarity: UI-TARS-2B-SFT belongs to arXiv:2501.12326, while no verified checkpoint or dataset for arXiv:2509.02544 was found.

• 先读第 2.1—2.2 节，重建真实数据单元：任务、两级记忆、推理/动作/观测步骤、共享状态和环境生命周期。
  • 阅读第 2.3—2.5 节时，要区分三个阶段：来源获取与 CT 标注、on-policy interactive SFT 修订、RL 任务与奖励构造。飞轮把它们连接起来，但论文没有发布路由账本。
  • 把奖励契约视为三套不同机制，而不是一套：游戏的确定性函数、GUI-Browsing 的参考答案判定、GUI-General 的 UI-TARS-2 outcome 评分。
  • 300 条轨迹的 reward model 结果必须和论文承认的假阳性问题一起阅读。它是评估器证据，不是训练数据质量证明。
  • 核验官方资产时应按论文身份而非名称相似度判断：UI-TARS-2B-SFT 属于 arXiv:2501.12326；目前未找到 arXiv:2509.02544 对应的已验证权重或数据集。

value.html: Continual pre-training draws on task tutorials, instructional videos, internet demonstrations, in-house data, prior UI-TARS and UI-TARS-1.5 training data, open-source agent trajectories, and in-house annotations. Reinforcement-learning tasks are synthesized separately for GUI-Browsing, GUI-General, and games. Item inventories, per-source counts, dates, and rights are unknown.

value_zh.html: 持续预训练取用任务教程、教学视频、互联网演示、内部数据、先前 UI-TARS 与 UI-TARS-1.5 训练数据、开源智能体轨迹与内部标注。强化学习任务分别为 GUI-Browsing、GUI-General 与游戏单独合成。条目清单、逐来源计数、日期与权利未知。

value.html: A GUI episode is a sequence of ReAct steps. Each step couples a reasoning trace, a GUI or SDK action, and a resulting observation under a task instruction, recent Working Memory, and compressed Episodic Memory. Outcomes and rewards are episode-level. Game records additionally expose a unified JSON result with scalar reward, termination flag, game version, and verification checksum; the report does not establish that this JSON schema covers every GUI domain.

value_zh.html: 一条 GUI episode 是一系列 ReAct 步骤。每一步将推理轨迹、GUI 或 SDK 动作与所得观察，在任务指令、近期 Working Memory 与压缩 Episodic Memory 下耦合。结果与奖励为 episode 级。游戏记录另外暴露带标量奖励、终止标志、游戏版本与核验校验和的统一 JSON 结果；报告未确立该 JSON schema 覆盖每一个 GUI 域。

value.html: Think-aloud experts and novices create in-situ demonstrations; interactive-SFT annotators accept or replace on-policy model proposals; the latest reinforcement-learning policy generates flywheel trajectories; unnamed language and vision-language models help synthesize or refine tasks. Item-level attribution is unknown.

value.html: A shared-filesystem sandbox combines cloud VMs for Windows, Ubuntu, and Android with browser, file, terminal, software-development, and MCP-style tools. GUI control uses PyAutoGUI or ADB; observations include screenshots and recordings. A separate browser sandbox runs HTML5/WebGL games and exposes page, score, level, and other runtime state through JavaScript interfaces.

value_zh.html: 共享文件系统沙箱将 Windows、Ubuntu 与 Android 的云虚拟机与浏览器、文件、终端、软件开发及 MCP 风格工具结合。GUI 控制使用 PyAutoGUI 或 ADB；观察包括截图与录制。单独的浏览器沙箱运行 HTML5/WebGL 游戏，并通过 JavaScript 接口暴露页面、分数、关卡与其他运行时状态。

value.html: Deterministic game tasks use function-based binary correctness; GUI-Browsing uses a reference-answer judge, identified in the analysis as GPT-4o-as-judge; open-ended GUI-General uses UI-TARS-2 as a generative outcome reward model over the full text history and last five screenshots. Some scenarios add format rewards and length penalties. Prompts, thresholds, calibration, and reward-combination details are unknown.

value_zh.html: 确定性游戏任务使用基于函数的二元正确性；GUI-Browsing 使用参考答案评审，分析中指认为 GPT-4o-as-judge；开放式 GUI-General 使用 UI-TARS-2 作为生成式结果奖励模型，作用于完整文本历史与最后五张截图。某些场景加入格式奖励与长度惩罚。提示、阈值、校准与奖励组合细节未知。

value.html: Termination is environment-dependent: game scripts return a termination flag with runtime-state checks; browsing tasks are judged against reference answers; general GUI tasks receive a scalar success score from the outcome reward model. The agent can also stop or exhaust a budget, but exact success thresholds, timeout rules, and failure-code semantics are unknown.

value_zh.html: 终止取决于环境：游戏脚本返回带运行时状态检查的终止标志；浏览任务对照参考答案判定；一般 GUI 任务从结果奖励模型获得标量成功分数。智能体也可以停止或耗尽预算，但精确成功阈值、超时规则与失败码语义未知。

value.html: UI-TARS-2 starts from Seed-thinking-1.6, including its post-training data. The report specifies a 532M-parameter vision encoder and a Mixture-of-Experts language model with 23B active and 230B total parameters; the exact starting checkpoint identifier and downloadable weights are unknown.

value_zh.html: UI-TARS-2 从 Seed-thinking-1.6 起步，包括其训练后数据。报告指明 532M 参数视觉编码器与 23B 激活、230B 总参数的 Mixture-of-Experts 语言模型；精确起始 checkpoint 标识符与可下载权重未知。

value.html: Human experts and novices provide demonstrations; interactive annotators supervise on-policy proposals; unnamed language and vision-language models synthesize, score, transcribe, or refine tasks; GPT-4o judges GUI-Browsing outcomes; UI-TARS-2 serves as the GUI-General outcome reward model. Versions and most teacher identities are unknown.

value_zh.html: 人类专家与新手提供演示；交互式标注者监督 on-policy 提议；未具名的语言与视觉语言模型合成、打分、转写或精炼任务；GPT-4o 判定 GUI-Browsing 结果；UI-TARS-2 作为 GUI-General 结果奖励模型。版本与大多数教师身份未知。

value.html: The pipeline cycles continual pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning. The current policy produces environment-interaction episodes; a validation function routes high-quality episodes into supervised fine-tuning and lower-quality episodes into continual pre-training before the next cycle. Synthetic task construction and human annotation supply cold-start and refreshed task pools.

value_zh.html: 流水线循环持续预训练、监督微调与强化学习。当前策略产生环境交互 episodes；验证函数在下一循环前将高质量 episodes 路由到监督微调、将较低质量 episodes 路由到持续预训练。合成任务构建与人工标注提供冷启动与刷新的任务池。

value.html: Interactive supervised fine-tuning samples current-policy proposals inside controlled environments and lets annotators accept or override them; the task pool and model are refreshed periodically. Reinforcement learning uses asynchronous server-mode inference and a dynamic pool: training starts once completed traces reach a minimum batch threshold, while incomplete stateful episodes remain for later iterations. Sampling temperature, candidate counts, allocation weights, and random seeds are unknown.

value_zh.html: 交互式监督微调在受控环境内采样当前策略提议，并让标注者接受或覆盖它们；任务池与模型定期刷新。强化学习使用异步 server-mode 推断与动态池：一旦已完成轨迹达到最小 batch 阈值即开始训练，而未完成的有状态 episodes 留给后续迭代。采样温度、候选计数、分配权重与随机种子未知。

value.html: Continual-pre-training tasks undergo executability checks, deduplication, dual-annotator review, difficulty scoring, ASR transcription, and model-assisted refinement. GUI-Browsing synthesis removes revealing attributes and tasks solvable by prior knowledge or one search. GUI-General excludes inaccessible, login-gated, static-information, and casual-game sites, then removes simple functions and checks executability. Numerical thresholds and acceptance yields are unknown.

value_zh.html: 持续预训练任务经过可执行性检查、去重、双标注者审查、难度打分、ASR 转写与模型辅助精炼。GUI-Browsing 合成移除揭示性属性以及可由先验知识或一次搜索解决的任务。GUI-General 排除不可访问、需登录、静态信息与休闲游戏站点，然后移除简单功能并检查可执行性。数值阈值与接受产量未知。

value.html: Training rollout step caps, token limits, wall-clock timeouts, and retry budgets are unknown. The GUI-General outcome reward model receives full text history but only the last five screenshots.

value_zh.html: 训练 rollout 步数上限、token 限制、墙钟超时与重试预算未知。GUI-General 结果奖励模型接收完整文本历史但仅最后五张截图。

value.html: Domain-specific PPO runs use final-outcome rewards, optional format and length shaping, Decoupled GAE, Length-Adaptive GAE, value-model pretraining, and asymmetric clipping. Specialized GUI-Browsing, GUI-General, game, and GUI-SDK policies are merged by parameter interpolation. Coefficients, clipping values, learning rates, batch sizes, minimum pool size, and training compute are unknown.

value_zh.html: 领域特定 PPO 运行使用最终结果奖励、可选格式与长度塑造、Decoupled GAE、Length-Adaptive GAE、价值模型预训练与非对称裁剪。专门的 GUI-Browsing、GUI-General、游戏与 GUI-SDK 策略通过参数插值合并。系数、裁剪值、学习率、batch sizes、最小池大小与训练算力未知。

value.html: The report names internet tutorials and demonstrations, videos, open-source trajectories, in-house annotations, prior UI-TARS data, general chat/reasoning data, synthetic tasks, and on-policy episodes. It gives no total trajectory count, item manifest, mixture weights, source URLs, collection dates, or per-source licenses.

value_zh.html: 报告点名互联网教程与演示、视频、开源轨迹、内部标注、先前 UI-TARS 数据、一般聊天/推理数据、合成任务与 on-policy episodes。它未给出总轨迹计数、条目清单、混合物权重、来源 URLs、收集日期或逐来源许可。

value.html: Training cycles and domain-specialized runs are described, but train/validation/test splits, cross-cycle deduplication, website-level holdouts, and overlap between continual pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and evaluation tasks are unknown.

value_zh.html: 描述了训练循环与领域专门运行，但 train/validation/test 划分、跨循环去重、网站级留出，以及持续预训练、监督微调、强化学习与评测任务之间的重叠未知。

value.html: The report describes task filtering and deduplication but does not publish benchmark-decontamination methods, matching thresholds, overlap reports, or source-level exclusions. Reported benchmark scores therefore cannot establish independence of the training data.

value_zh.html: 报告描述了任务过滤与去重，但未发布基准去污染方法、匹配阈值、重叠报告或来源级排除。因此所报告的基准分数不能确立训练数据的独立性。

items: The GUI-General outcome reward model has a reported high false-positive tendency, so incorrect final states can receive positive reward.
Using only the last five screenshots can omit earlier visual evidence needed to verify long episodes.
Stateful websites, operating systems, applications, and games can drift, so an instruction and action trace are not replayable without versioned snapshots and reset scripts.
Episodes collected on annotators' personal computers create privacy, consent, and redaction risks that the report does not resolve.
Lower-quality flywheel episodes are routed into continual pre-training; without routing thresholds or rejection logs, error propagation cannot be audited.
The public research repository and desktop client do not provide the reported training corpus, reward data, sandbox images, or UI-TARS-2 checkpoint.
GUI-General 结果奖励模型据报告有高假阳性倾向，因此不正确的终态可获得正奖励。
仅使用最后五张截图可能省略核验长 episodes 所需的更早视觉证据。
有状态网站、操作系统、应用与游戏可能漂移，因此没有版本化快照与重置脚本时，一条指令与动作轨迹不可重放。
在标注者个人计算机上收集的 episodes 造成报告未解决的隐私、同意与脱敏风险。
较低质量的飞轮 episodes 被路由到持续预训练；没有路由阈值或拒绝日志，错误传播无法审计。
公开研究仓库与桌面客户端不提供所报告的训练语料、奖励数据、沙箱镜像或 UI-TARS-2 checkpoint。

value.html: The official UI-TARS and UI-TARS-desktop repositories use Apache-2.0, but that code license does not grant rights to unreleased tasks, screenshots, videos, annotations, website content, game assets, or model outputs. Training-data licenses, annotator consent terms, and redistribution rights are unknown.

value_zh.html: 官方 UI-TARS 与 UI-TARS-desktop 仓库使用 Apache-2.0，但该代码许可并不授予未发布任务、截图、视频、标注、网站内容、游戏资产或模型输出的权利。训练数据许可、标注者同意条款与再分发权利未知。

value.html: The report provides a system-level lineage from Seed-thinking-1.6 through continual pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, domain-specific PPO, rejection filtering, flywheel recycling, and parameter interpolation. Record-level provenance, accepted/rejected ledgers, checkpoint-to-data mappings, and replayable environment versions are unavailable.
